gameplay_and_system_updates.details: Relocated functions and increased overall size of all lobby buttons for better UI/UX accessibility
Added option in settings menu to sprint by dragging joystick
Retired separate Activity Missions menu and combined rewards into Fire Pass Missions menu

optimizations_and_bug_fixes: Likes received at the end of match displayed on match results page
SMG ammo 3D model updated to match icon
Fixed Clash Squad bug where 'waiting for players' message remained after teams filled
Hiding own pet will now automatically hide teammates' pets
Unusable ammo types grayed out/shown in inventory
Reduced bomb transparency in Bomb Squad
Removed advanced attachments UI icon displays from the map
Added notification sound when team captain starts matchmaking
Air Hammers prohibited from Combat Zone in Training Grounds
Added matchmaking queue for 1v1 ring in Training Grounds
